issues.description: Command names use underscore_reload but tests/feature files invoke dash-separated names
issues.detail: Python defines `quickmarks_reload` and `bookmarks_reload`, which qutebrowser's cmdutils typically exposes as `quickmarks-reload`/`bookmarks-reload`. The feature tests invoke `:bookmarks-reload` and `:quickmarks-reload`. Other commands in the file use singular forms like `quickmark_save`/`bookmark_add`. The plural naming is inconsistent with the existing convention and should be `quickmark-reload`/`bookmark-reload` for consistency.

issues.description: reload() does not re-initialize lineparser path, may read stale cached state
issues.detail: `reload()` calls `_init_lineparser()` which constructs a new LineParser pointing at the same file. However, if the file was modified externally, behavior depends on LineParser reading fresh from disk on construction. Worth verifying `_init_lineparser` actually re-reads the file rather than returning cached contents, otherwise the reload silently does nothing.

issues.description: No unsaved-changes guard before clearing marks on reload
issues.detail: `reload()` calls `self.marks.clear()` and re-reads from disk unconditionally. If the user added quickmarks/bookmarks in this session that haven't been flushed to disk (or the save-manager hasn't fired yet), those entries are silently discarded. Consider warning the user or saving pending changes first.

issues.description: Scenarios missing descriptive names in feature file
issues.detail: The two new scenarios are declared as bare `Scenario:` with no title, unlike every other scenario in this feature file which has a descriptive name (e.g. `Scenario: Saving a quickmark`). This hurts readability of test reports and is inconsistent with the surrounding style.

issues.description: Constructor now emits changed signal where it previously did not
issues.detail: Previously `__init__` populated `self.marks` directly without emitting `changed`. After this refactor, `__init__` calls `reload()` which emits `self.changed`. Any connected slot wired up before construction completes could fire unexpectedly. In practice nothing is connected this early, but the behavior change is worth noting.

issues.description: Missing changelog/doc entry for new commands
issues.detail: Two new user-facing commands are added but there's no update to doc/changelog.asciidoc or the commands documentation. qutebrowser typically requires a changelog entry for new commands and auto-generated command docs. Verify the doc generation will pick these up and add a changelog line.

review.summary: The PR adds `quickmarks_reload`/`bookmarks_reload` commands by extracting a `reload()` method on `UrlMarkManager`. The refactor is clean and well-tested, but there are naming inconsistencies (plural vs singular, and underscore vs dash in invocation), a potential issue with discarding unsaved in-memory marks on reload, and missing changelog/scenario titles. The core logic change is small and low-risk, but the command naming should be reconciled with existing conventions before merge.
